item.title: 50/50 Bachata & Salsa on Thursdays — Thu Nov 5, 7:00 PM — Neruda’s Brunswick
item.description:
Spring has sprung! Let’s dance! Showy Dance Melbourne & Neruda Brunswick joined forces to bring a night for Bachata & Salsa class + a Social dance night! Every Thursday from 7 pm. 7 pm: Bachata class. 8 pm: Salsa class. 9 pm: Social night. After the 2 classes finished, we will continue the night with Social dance. item.title: Salsa Thursdays at Time Out Market — Thu Nov 5, 7:00 PM — Time Out Market New York
item.description:
Join us for one of NYC’s best free salsa nights and turn your Thursday into a dance-floor celebration.
Get your salsa on every Thursday night at Time Out Market New York! Head up to the fifth floor for an electrifying evening of rhythm, movement, and Latin vibes. Whether you’re a total beginner or a seasoned dancer, this is your weekly excuse to move, sweat, and smile. Starting at 7:30 PM, renowned instructor Marlene Veras will guide you through the steps, breaking down the fundamentals so you feel confident on the dance floor. The night is powered by infectious beats from DJ Ray Suave, with live percussion by Jessica La Timbalera, setting the stage for a high-energy salsa experience. After the lesson, the floor opens up for a full-on salsa dance party until 10 PM. Bring a partner or come solo—everyone’s welcome.
Source: Go Latin Dance

item.title: Faculty-led Study Abroad Courses Information Session for faculty members — Wed Nov 11, 2:00 PM
item.description:
York International (YI) is accepting proposals for faculty-led study abroad courses and programs for 2027/28 and 2028/29. YI offers many supports to faculty leads and instructors including international partnership support, program and budget planning and vendor-service provider coordination, student recruitment and promotions, logistical arrangements, student funding, safety abroad training and travel risk management. Students may also be eligible for York International Mobility Award (YIMA) upon completion of safety abroad training and procedures. We have funding available to support students studying abroad in the following destinations, and we encourage faculty members to consider developing faculty-led study abroad courses in these locations:
China (Canada Learning Initiative in China, CLIC funding) Germany (3 Endowed Awards)

item.title: TNT Pub Night+AI Tools for Small Businesses (Short Talk) - Fri, Nov 13 @ 7:30 pm — Fri Nov 13, 7:30 PM
item.description:
Try New Things in Toronto! Our pub nights are always popular. We had a blast at Pauper's Pub in the past, so we're heading there once again. Come out and enjoy a drink, get to meet other TNT members and have a lot of fun!
We are starting at 7:30 p.m., but you can arrive or leave whenever you like.
How to get to Pauper's Pub
